independentReviewSearch.result: No reliable, dimensioned independent on-snow test clearly matching this model and season was found in this search batch. Search results included an informal first-person Reddit comment about an SNB-100, but it did not disclose board year, size, snow conditions, test duration, or rider details; it was not used to calibrate scores.

scoringEvidence.decision: Retain all six scores as provisional editorial estimates. Official copy supports the beginner-friendly, forgiving, soft-flex and low-speed-playful intent, while explicitly warning about high-speed/frozen-snow carving limits. Those claims are not independent ride measurements and do not justify converting flex or terrain percentages to score values. Park 5.7 is a general beginner-freestyle estimate, not an observed feature-park score. Float 4.2 is weak-confidence because the board is short, nearly centered, and official copy only says flat+rocker aids float; no powder test was found. Value 9.2 is the least defensible dimension because the normalized CAD price is not a China-market price.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low across all six dimensions; forgiveness has the clearest directional support from official design intent, while float and value have particularly weak empirical/local-market support.
